desc:
Don't trust the furniture.

🔦 SURVIVORS: Hack the consoles and last five minutes. Bring trip mines, bear traps, a grapple hook... or C4 that takes the room with it.
🪑 MONSTERS: Possess the furniture. Hide in plain sight, strike when they walk past, and burn through walls with your eye laser.

That chair wasn't there a second ago 👀
